en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing an ocean liner at sea, viewed from the side. A large hand from above appears to lower or raise one of the ship's funnels like a magician's trick. There is handwritten cursive text over much of the image, typical of early 20th‑century postcards. Along the bottom margin, partially readable printed text includes the words "…LINE…", "BELFAST", and "DO…" (likely part of a longer caption naming the ship and builder).
